decisions.executionNote: Establish elbow-up bend with open left gripper before approaching the mallet handle near center-left; right arm remains parked.
Move left arm inward above the handle, gradually orienting downward with jaws aligned to the mallet shaft; maintain elbow-up continuity.
Complete downward handle alignment while approaching from above; stop short of the table to inspect wrist alignment.
Lower gently around the handle with a small lateral centering correction; keep jaws open until shaft is between them.
Shaft is centered in the wrist view; finish the small descent and close the left gripper around its handle.
Lift the closed grasp to verify retention, moving left and rotating the mallet toward the first key while keeping clear of the keys.
Mallet is visibly retained. Translate above the leftmost red key and finish turning the shaft forward; keep the tip lifted during transit.
Center the mallet tip over the leftmost red bar, then descend conservatively for the first strike; inspect contact before moving right.
Complete the first red-key tap, then lift the mallet more than 0.025 m before starting the rightward move to key two.

Lift 0.06 m clear of the final magenta key and hold the retained mallet above the instrument, completing the required post-hit lift.
The final contact was visually shallow. Give the last key a slightly deeper vertical tap, then lift more than 0.025 m.
